sonic-route.description: A native macOS menu bar app for per-app audio volume, mute, and output routing.

episodic-app-web.description: Episodic — TV series tracker web app (Next.js 16 + Chakra UI v3, Geist design)

episodic-app-backend.description: Episodic — serverless API for a TV series tracker (Rust, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, TMDB)

episodic-app-infra-cloud.description: Episodic — AWS infrastructure (Terraform: API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge)

alpaca-extfs-for-mac.description: A high-performance user-space Ext4 filesystem driver for macOS with full Read & Write support natively integrated into Finder, built with Rust, macFUSE, and Linux's official libext2fs (e2fsprogs 1.47.4).

SaabAudioMixingConsoleStreaming.description: Ultra-low-latency distributed audio mixing console in Rust. Streams macOS system audio via CoreAudio BlackHole HAL and UDP to Android 12+ (Google Oboe/AAudio P2 3.5mm jack) with tactile touch faders and ITU-R BS.775 surround downmixing.

dota-collection-tool.description: Local Dota 2 game-state collector: HTTP sink + manager CLI over SQLite

memory-for-agents-llm.description: This repository is the reference for a coding-agent memory system that works across sessions, across repos, and across agent runtimes. It keeps transient conversation small and turns reusable knowledge into source-backed, versioned Markdown. Claude Code and Codex are both first-class clients of the same canonical memory, ingestion hooks, and MCP
